### Canada Goose to Announce Second Quarter Fiscal Year 2027 Financial Results on November 5, 2026


October 15, 2026


TORONTO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Canada Goose Holdings Inc. (NYSE, TSX: GOOS) plans to announce results for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027, which ended September 27, 2026, before markets open on Thursday, November 5, 2026.


The Company will host a conference call and webcast to discuss second quarter fiscal 2027 results at 8:30am ET on Thursday, November 5, 2026. A live webcast of the conference call will be available on the company’s website at[http://investor.canadagoose.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Finvestor.canadagoose.com&esheet=54617611&newsitemid=20261015802424&lan=en-US&anchor=http%3A%2F%2Finvestor.canadagoose.com&index=1&md5=eef224d9eb5e3c0da33b2ecbe8663d8d) . The conference call can be accessed by using the following link:[Canada Goose Q2 2027 Earnings Call](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.google.com%2Furl%3Fq%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fevents.q4inc.com%252Fattendee%252F566276627%26sa%3DD%26source%3Dcalendar%26ust%3D1788795360000000%26usg%3DAOvVaw0w-d7ghKo47z320Pyanm6T&esheet=54617611&newsitemid=20261015802424&lan=en-US&anchor=Canada+Goose+Q2+2027+Earnings+Call&index=2&md5=430a7ede64a986843bc0025c33d5f114) . After registering, an email including the conference call link will be sent to join the live call.


An archived replay of the webcast will be available shortly after the conclusion of the call.


**About Canada Goose**


Canada Goose is dedicated to empowering discovery and pushing boundaries in design, functionality, and style. Inspired by our Canadian heritage, we craft high-performance outerwear, apparel, footwear, and accessories that elevate craftsmanship and embrace individuality. Rooted in resilience and driven by a pioneering spirit, we embolden explorers to thrive in all environments while preserving the planet they roam. For more information, visit[www.canadagoose.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.canadagoose.com%2F&esheet=54617611&newsitemid=20261015802424&lan=en-US&anchor=www.canadagoose.com&index=3&md5=c5784e6dbb7abb01911008f57c79698e) .
